artifacts.summary: Ten-phase plan extending the Lean appendix to the semantic layer, a derived theorem and its semantic counterpart, derivations as data, the metalogic result map, the decision procedure, and a generator-derived project overview, with a standing four-gate per-phase check.

memory_candidates.content: In BimodalLogic's typst pipeline, a cited figure is only drift-proof when the generator and the checker are extended in the same change. scripts/typst-status-counts.sh writes typst/generated/status.typ, but scripts/typst-sync-check.sh Check 2 compares only a hard-coded scalar_fields list plus a live_map dict. A new #let binding added to status.typ without matching keys in both of those is invisible to the check, so a stale number sits in the book with the sync check green. Check 2's comparison also matches integers only (regex (\d+)), so a string-valued figure such as a version pin reports MISSING on every run unless the comparison path is widened first. The generator's --json branch is what Check 2 consumes and it must run without a lake build, so any new figure has to be a filesystem or git read rather than a #print axioms read. The reliable acceptance test for such a change is perturbation: hand-edit one committed figure, confirm the check fails naming that field, restore it, confirm PASS.
